No. getValue fails: a function whose declared type is neither undefined, void nor any must return a value. logValue compiles (TypeScript 5.1+).

Why: Since TypeScript 5.1, a function that returns undefined needs no return statement, just like JavaScript. A function promising a string must return one.

Docs: TypeScript 5.1 release notes — https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-5-1.html
quote: In JavaScript, if a function finishes running without hitting a return, it returns the value undefined.
